meta.title: Edit name and profile picture in My profile

args.goal: Hover over the signed-in buyer's User Profile icon, click My profile, open the side panel, press Edit, change the user's name and/or profile picture, press Save, and stop when the profile panel or profile submenu shows the updated name.

steps.note: Executes and verifies the unavailable profile editing workflow in the buyer session.
Confirms the profile result screen has no crash, server error, undefined values, or raw identifiers.
